title: Home Assistant action <ns>.report_location (fields)
description: Integration action for the position of a device with a Home Assistant key (docs/location.md): works at home and away (Nabu Casa, external URL), also for read-only device users (control path checked). Allowed for every authenticated user; only device users of the integration with a rule snapshot get anything done (others: not_a_device, rules_missing). The integration checks the rule location of the snapshot (off → location_not_allowed, background fix with foreground → location_background_not_allowed), the age of ts (location_stale) and one report per 5 s per device (rate_limited), updates the device's device_tracker and sends the hub only metadata (POST /api/integration/location-status, never coordinates). Refusals raise ServiceValidationError (translation_domain <ns>, translation_key = $defs/location_report_reason). Called by apps over the HA WebSocket (call_service domain <ns>, service report_location, service_data = this object, return_response true) or REST POST /api/services/<ns>/report_location?return_response. Apps never call device_tracker.see.

background.description: Fix taken while the app was not in the foreground.

location_shared.description: What the app shares now; forwarded to the hub (admin UI).
